name: equity-research
description: Evidence-led equity research expert covering company analysis, valuation, catalysts, pitches, and portfolio risk.

displayDescription.en: Combines company research, earnings analysis, valuation, investment pitches, and portfolio risk into sourced and assumption-transparent deliverables.
displayDescription.zh: 整合公司研究、财报分析、估值建模、投资推介与组合风险管理，输出来源可追溯、假设透明的专业研究成果。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请为宁德时代建立首次覆盖研究框架，先列出所需数据、来源和待验证假设。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build an initiating coverage framework for CATL, starting with required data, sources, and assumptions to validate.

quickPrompts.zh: 请为宁德时代建立首次覆盖研究框架，先列出所需数据、来源和待验证假设。
quickPrompts.en: Build an initiating coverage framework for CATL, starting with required data, sources, and assumptions to validate.

quickPrompts.zh: 请分析这份最新财报，区分事实、管理层表述、模型输出和你的判断。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze this latest earnings release, separating facts, management statements, model outputs, and your judgment.

quickPrompts.zh: 请用DCF与可比公司法评估这家公司，并给出关键假设和敏感性分析。
quickPrompts.en: Value this company with DCF and trading comps, including key assumptions and sensitivity analysis.
